mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is the continuous level of FEDFUNDS, with lower values predicting higher returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 9.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which suppress corporate earnings growth and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 9.0), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 225) indicate a favorable monetary policy environment that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS < 0.5 AND CPIAUCSL < 225), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes defined by GDP growth exceeding 3% and unemployment rate below 5.0%, equity markets are overvalued and prone to correction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (GDPC1 growth > 3% AND UNRATE < 5.0), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is the continuous level of INDPRO, with higher values predicting higher returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO is above 95.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Weak labor market growth (PAYEMS 3-month growth rate < 0.5%) signals insufficient job creation to support consumer spending, which suppresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (PAYEMS growth < 0.5% in 3 months), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Weak residential sales (RSAFS < 380000) indicate a contracting housing market, which reduces consumer wealth and confidence, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (RSAFS < 380000), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL) compresses real earnings and increases monetary policy tightening risks, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is the continuous level of CPIAUCSL, with higher values predicting lower returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL is above 225.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
